Eligibility in detail (official notice, Advt 01/2023)

The posts were in the municipal corporations, councils and nagar panchayats under the Local Government Department (non-cadre Group C). Applications ran from 28 January to 28 February 2023.

FiremanDriver/Operator
EducationMatric (minimum)Middle (8th) (minimum)
Licence and experience-A heavy-vehicle driving licence held for at least 5 years, and experience of running repairs to vehicles and fire appliances
PunjabiMatric standardMatric standard
Age18 to 37 on the last date of application, relaxation as per government policySame

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the eligibility for PSSSB Fireman?

The 2023 notice asked for matric (minimum) for Fireman, age 18-37 on the last date of application with the usual relaxations, height 5 ft 5 in, chest 33.5 in with 1.5 in expansion (men), 6/6 eyesight without glasses, and a qualifying physical test.
